# HBR Rentals

> Property management services specializing in Tracy, Manteca, Pleasanton, and Mountain House, CA, with expertise in California landlord compliance, tenant screening, and maintenance coordination.

HBR Rentals provides comprehensive property management solutions for California landlords, offering Gold, Platinum, and Lease-Only service tiers. The company maintains strong expertise in California rental laws including AB 1482 (Tenant Protection Act), AB 628 (Appliance Requirements), and AB 2801 (Security Deposit updates), serving the Central Valley and Bay Area markets.

## Key Topics

- California landlord compliance
- AB 1482 Tenant Protection Act
- Tracy property management
- Tenant screening and placement
- Maintenance coordination
- Security deposit regulations
- Eviction laws and processes
- AB 628 appliance requirements
- PropertyMeld maintenance platform
- Rental property ROI
- Landlord insurance (SureVestor)
- Habitability standards (Civil Code 1941.2)
- Manteca and Pleasanton markets
- Agent referral programs
